summary: Gold X2 Mining Inc., a Vancouver-based gold explorer listed on NYSE American and TSXV (AUXX), filed a Form 6-K disclosing completion of its previously announced purchase of 42 unpatented mineral claims near Thunder Bay, Ontario, from Bold Ventures Inc. Consideration comprised C$500,000 cash, 150,000 Gold X2 common shares and a 2% NSR royalty on Canadian critical minerals excluding copper, with a buyback right on half the NSR for C$1,000,000. The acquired claims adjoin Gold X2's Moss Gold Project and carry an existing 3% NSR, half purchasable for C$2.5 million. No board recommendation or advisor was disclosed; closing already occurred November 11, 2026. Watch royalty stacking and buyback economics.
